title: Exponent Profiles of Oscillatory Matrices under Matrix and Inverse Sparsity
summary: We classify the simultaneous half-bandwidths \(p,q\) of a symmetric oscillatory matrix \(A\) and its inverse. At order \(n\ge2\), the possible pairs are \((1,n-1)\), \((n-1,1)\), and all pairs with \(2\le p,q\le n-1\). Every pair has an integer realization of determinant one. Let \(e_k(A)\) be the least positive integer \(m\) for which all minors of order \(k\) of \(A^m\) are positive. We prove \[ e_k(A)\le \min\{\max\{k,n-p\},\max\{n-k,n-q\}\}\qquad(1\le k<n). \] When \(p+q\ge n\), one realization attains all these bounds simultaneously.
